pretreatment: exposure to 10% ozone in 400 sccm O2 for 10 min
evidence: Flat and nanoporous Ir films were prepared by ALD onto glass and AAO templates, respectively. Ir ALD was conducted in a viscous flow reactor maintained at a pressure of ~ 1 Torr under a flow of 130 sccm N2 (99.999% purity) carrier gas and a temperature of 300 °C. After loading into the reactor, all substrates were thermally equilibrated for 10 min and then cleaned in situ by exposure to 10% ozone in 400 sccm O2 for 10 min.
